response.overview: THE MCADO, or THE TOWN OF BALLYDEW - The Gilbert and Sullivan Very Light Opera Co. of Minneapolis produced this in November 2024. This marked the regional premiere of a concept originally developed by Gilbert and Sullivan Austin. Additional concept material (including the Prologue) and alternate lyrics ("I've Got a Little List" and "A More Humane McAdo") are credited to director Joe Andrews.  This production is dedicated to the memory of company member and House Manager, Fred Morrison.  Click on the Closed-Captioning button for accurate subtitles! (available in English; click "English - United States")  Trigger Warning: THE MCADO includes discussions of suicide.
response.title: The McAdo 2024
